vo.text: In this photo, Earth is less than one pixel. Zero point one two of a pixel.
vo.cap: Earth: less than *one pixel.* *0.12* of a pixel.

vo.text: Voyager 1 took it in 1990, six billion kilometers from home.
Carl Sagan pushed NASA to turn its camera back toward Earth, one last time.
vo.cap: Carl Sagan: turn the camera *back toward Earth.*

vo.text: Soon after, Voyager's cameras were switched off. For good.
vo.cap: Then its cameras were *switched off.* For good.

vo.text: Does this make you feel small, or lucky? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.
